dialogue.content: こんばんは
dialogue.English: Good evening.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: It's a pleasure to speak with you.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.English: It's nice to speak with you too.

dialogue.content: では、早速ですが始めましょう
dialogue.English: Well then, shall we get started?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。今日はどのようなご相談ですか
dialogue.English: Hello, I’m the counselor. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 娘が学校行きたくないらしく、困ってます。
dialogue.English: My daughter doesn't seem to want to go to school, and I'm worried.

dialogue.content: それは不安になりますね
dialogue.English: That must be worrying for you.

dialogue.content: それはいつごろからになりますか
dialogue.English: Since about when has this been going on?

dialogue.content: 先週から登校再開してるのですが、まだ学校行ってません・・・
dialogue.English: School resumed last week, but she still hasn’t gone...

dialogue.content: それは困りますしご心配ですよね
dialogue.English: That must be difficult and worrisome for you.

dialogue.content: はい心配です
dialogue.English: Yes, I’m worried.

dialogue.content: もう少し詳しく状況をお話し頂いても大丈夫ですか
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if you told me a bit more about the situation?

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, of course.

dialogue.content: お子さんは普段はどんな感じの方ですか
dialogue.English: What is your daughter usually like?

dialogue.content: 普段はバスケ大好きな、元気な子です
dialogue.English: She’s usually an energetic kid who loves basketball.

dialogue.content: 元気なお子さんなのですね？
dialogue.English: So she’s a lively child, is that right?

dialogue.content: それは余計に気係ですよね
dialogue.English: That must make it even more concerning.

dialogue.content: はい！
dialogue.English: Yes!

dialogue.content: 何か行きたくなくなるようなお心当たりはありますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have any idea what might be making her not want to go?

dialogue.content: わからないですが、コロナで外出自粛してからですかね
dialogue.English: I’m not sure, but perhaps it’s been since we started staying home due to the COVID restrictions.

dialogue.content: なるほど。。。
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 自粛中のお子さまはどの様な感じでしたか
dialogue.English: What was she like during the stay-at-home period?

dialogue.content: 元気なかったです
dialogue.English: She didn’t have much energy.

dialogue.content: ずっーと本を読んでました
dialogue.English: She was reading books pretty much all the time.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね？もしよろしければご家族構成などを教えていただけますか
dialogue.English: I see. If you don't mind, could you tell me about your family?

dialogue.content: 妻と、高2の長女、中2の長男です
dialogue.English: It's my wife, our oldest daughter who's a second-year in high school, and our son who's a second-year in middle school.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございますお父様でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. Are you her father?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 普段は娘さんとどのようなお話しをされますか
dialogue.English: What kinds of things do you usually talk about with your daughter?

dialogue.content: 普段はバスケの話しが多いですが、コロナ以降はあまり話しできてませんね
dialogue.English: We usually talk a lot about basketball, but we haven't talked much since the pandemic started.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。。。それはご心配のことと思います。
dialogue.English: I see... That must be worrying for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 奥様とは、そのことについてお話し合いはされましたか
dialogue.English: Have you discussed this with your wife?

dialogue.content: はい、同様に心配してます
dialogue.English: Yes, she’s equally worried.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。。。ご兄弟と娘さんのご関係はどんな感じでしょうか
dialogue.English: I see... What is your daughter's relationship with her brother like?

dialogue.content: コロナ以降は部屋に閉じこもりがちです
dialogue.English: Since the pandemic, she tends to shut herself in her room.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。。。
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: ほんとうに悩みますよね
dialogue.English: I can see how troubling this must be.

dialogue.content: はい、心配で
dialogue.English: Yes, I’m worried.

dialogue.content: 娘さんには理由をお話ししてはくださらない感じですか
dialogue.English: Does she not really share her reasons with you?

dialogue.content: そうですね、聞いても、いつもどおりと言ってます
dialogue.English: That's right. Even when I ask, she says everything is the same as usual.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 本を読まれていたようですが。。。
dialogue.English: You mentioned she was reading books...

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: その辺りは気になる感じはどうでしょう
dialogue.English: How do you feel about that aspect?

dialogue.content: 何を読んでるか、聞いてません。でも本に逃げてるように私は感じてます
dialogue.English: I haven't asked what she's reading, but I feel like she's escaping into books.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 自粛中にバスケのことやお友だちとのコミュニケーションは取れてisoudesitaka
dialogue.English: During the stay-at-home period, was she able to keep up with basketball or stay in touch with her friends?

dialogue.content: いしうでしたか
dialogue.English: Was that the case?

dialogue.content: すみません、いそうでしたか
dialogue.English: Sorry, I mean, did it seem like she was?

dialogue.content: わかりません、スマホは使ってますが・・・
dialogue.English: I’m not sure. She uses her smartphone, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: では、ここまでを少し振り返らせて頂いてよろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Okay, would it be all right if I took a moment to summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.content: はい！お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes! Please do.

dialogue.content: 娘さんがコロナ明けで学校が再開されているのに学校に行かないでいる
dialogue.English: Your daughter isn't going to school, even though it has reopened after the COVID lockdown.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 普段の娘さんはバスケットボールが好きな明るいお子さんですね。。。
dialogue.English: Usually, your daughter is a cheerful child who likes basketball...

dialogue.content: はい！
dialogue.English: Yes!

dialogue.content: コロナ自粛中から元気がなくなっていき
dialogue.English: She has been losing energy since the stay-at-home period,

dialogue.content: 本を読んだり部屋にこもるようになってしまったのですね
dialogue.English: and she's started reading books and shutting herself in her room.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That’s right.

dialogue.content: そして、お父様は娘さんのことをとてもご心配されているのですよね
dialogue.English: And you, as her father, are very worried about her.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 娘さんを思う素敵なおとうさまですよね
dialogue.English: You sound like a wonderful, caring father.

dialogue.content: 心配で・・・
dialogue.English: I’m just so worried...

dialogue.content: 本当にご心配ですよね。お父さまは、娘さんにどのようになって欲しいとお思いでしょうが。。。
dialogue.English: It's completely understandable to be worried. What would you like to see for your daughter?

dialogue.content: 元気にバスケして友達ともワイワイしてほしい以前のように
dialogue.English: I want her to be energetic, playing basketball and having fun with her friends, like before.

dialogue.content: 前のように元気な娘さんに戻ってほしいのですよね。。。
dialogue.English: You want her to go back to being her cheerful self, just like before...

dialogue.content: はい！
dialogue.English: Yes!

dialogue.content: どお接したらいいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How should I approach her?

dialogue.content: お父様は娘さん思いのはなしやすい方と思うのですがいかがですか？
dialogue.English: It seems to me that you're a caring and approachable father, wouldn't you say?

dialogue.content: 娘さんとのご関係ですが。。。
dialogue.English: Regarding your relationship with your daughter...

dialogue.content: 聞いても、変わらないって言うんですよ
dialogue.English: Even when I ask, she just says, “Nothing has changed.”

dialogue.content: ただ行きたくないと。。。
dialogue.English: She just doesn't want to go...

dialogue.content: 思春期でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is it adolescence?

dialogue.content: 進学するかは前から悩んでました
dialogue.English: She had been worried for a while about whether to go on to higher education.

dialogue.content: バスケで騒いでいた時期から
dialogue.English: Even back when she was all about basketball.

dialogue.content: コロナで自粛していろいろ考えが
dialogue.English: During the COVID restrictions, she started thinking about various things,

dialogue.content: 人生を考えだしたんですかね
dialogue.English: maybe she started thinking about her life.

dialogue.content: この先どうしようか、とか
dialogue.English: Like, what to do in the future.

dialogue.content: 進学のことがあったのですね。。。
dialogue.English: So the question of further education has been on her mind...

dialogue.content: 私も悩んだ時期ありましたから
dialogue.English: I had a time when I worried about that too.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それは、あるかもしれないですね。。。
dialogue.English: That could very well be the case...

dialogue.content: ですね
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: 少し話ししてみます
dialogue.English: I’ll try talking with her a little.

dialogue.content: その辺の
dialogue.English: About those topics.

dialogue.content: あまり学校に行かないということにふれずにそれとなく進学についてのおはなしをもちかけてみることはできそうですか？
dialogue.English: Do you think you could casually bring up the topic of her future education without directly mentioning her not going to school?

dialogue.content: はい、話してみます
dialogue.English: Yes, I’ll try talking with her.

dialogue.content: 寄り添うお気持ちでお話しできれば、きっと上手くいくとしんじています。
dialogue.English: If you can speak with her from a supportive, empathic stance, I believe it will go well.

dialogue.content: はい有難うございます！
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much!

dialogue.content: まだ解決までには時間がかかるかもしれませんがお父様の愛情で頑張ってくださいね
dialogue.English: It may still take some time to resolve, but please keep supporting her with your fatherly love.

dialogue.content: はい有難うございます！
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much!

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました。娘さんが元気になられることをお祈りしています。
dialogue.English: Thank you for speaking with me today. I hope your daughter feels better soon.

dialogue.content: はい有難うございました！
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much!

dialogue.content: これで今日は終了で大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: Shall we wrap up here for today?

dialogue.content: はい有難うございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 終わりますね
dialogue.English: We'll end here then.
